name: com.evernote.android.job.patched.internal.JobRescheduleService
description: When the patched Evernote Android Job library bundled with Yandex MapKit repairs its schedule, this Service checks saved jobs and restores those missing from the system; MapKit uses the jobs for offline-map downloads.
disableEffect: Offline-map download jobs with a lost schedule may remain stopped instead of being restored.
